Back of a length from Hasaranga, pitching on leg and angling across Hendricks. He backs away and drives for one run.
Back of a length from Hasaranga, pitching outside off stump. Hendricks gets on the back foot and cuts
Full ball, on leg stump and angled across. Khan pushes forward and flicks for 2 runs.
Full, outside off again. Khan gets on the front foot but misses while trying to play a drive
Short of a length, outside off stump. Hendricks moves onto the back foot and plays a defensive stroke behind point on the off side for a single run.
Good length from McCoy, outside leg. Khan gets on the front foot and guides a glance on the on side for a run.
Short of a length, pitching outside off again. Khan goes back, and is hit on the pads while attempting a scoop
Good length from McCoy, outside off stump once again. Khan moves onto the front foot but decides to let that one through to Fletcher without offering a shot
SIX MORE! Short ball, outside off once more. Hendricks gets on the front foot and plays a pull back behind square for six runs.
FOUR! Short, pitching outside off. Hendricks pushes forward and pulls for four runs.
Pitching on a good line and length. Hendricks gets forward and drives for a couple of runs through the leg side field.
Back of a length from Holder, pitching outside off stump. Khan goes back and drives for 1 run.
Good line and length from Holder once again. Khan gets on the front foot, and is hit on the pads while attempting a glance
Good line and length from Holder. Hendricks pushes forward and drives shakily for a single run.

commentary.label: 2w
commentary.commentary: Wide. Pitched up, pitching well down the leg side. Hendricks gets forward but swings and misses while attempting to play a leg glance
Good length, pitching on leg and angled across. Khan pushes forward and plays a defensive stroke
And another! Pitching on a good line and length once again. Khan moves onto the front foot and lifts a flick for 6 runs.
Back of a length, pitching on a good line again. Khan moves onto the back foot and plays a defensive stroke
Back of a length, on a good line. Khan gets on the back foot and plays a defensive stroke
Good line and length once more. Hendricks moves onto the front foot and defends down the ground for 1 run.
On a good line and length from Netravalkar. Khan moves onto the front foot and plays a defensive stroke for 1 run through point on the off side.

commentary.label: 8b
commentary.commentary: Back of a length from Holder, pitching outside off. Hendricks moves onto the back foot but misses while trying to defend, and the ball rolls away from Fletcher for four byes. The ball is misfielded by Fletcher costing four runs.
Back of a length from Holder, outside off stump once more. Khan gets on the front foot and cuts back behind point for one run.
Back of a length from Holder, pitching outside off stump. Khan gets on the back foot and cuts
Back of a length from Holder, on a good line. Hendricks moves onto the back foot and guides a glance back behind square for a single run.
Good length from Holder, outside off. Khan moves onto the front foot and cuts late back behind point for 1 run.
Back of a length from Holder, on line once more. Hendricks goes back and glances for a run.
Good line and length. Khan moves onto the front foot and plays a defensive stroke

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Netravalkar gets the wicket! Short of a length, outside off again. Carty gets on the back foot and edges, and is caught by Fletcher
Good length, outside off stump once more. Carty pushes forward but misses while trying a drive
Good length, pitching outside off stump. Carty pushes forward and defends

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Bowled. Good length from Netravalkar, pitching outside off stump. McKenzie gets on the front foot and edges, the stumps are disturbed, and McKenzie has to go

Short of a length, outside off stump. McKenzie gets on the back foot, and is hit on the pads while trying to play a defensive stroke. The umpire gives McKenzie out LBW, however McKenzie signals for a review. The decision is overturned by DRS.
